bead.title: Ratify sticky utilization routing specs
bead.description: Update and verify the routing design documents for sticky utilization-aware local endpoint routing. In-scope files: docs/helix/01-frame/features/FEAT-004-model-routing.md, docs/helix/02-design/adr/ADR-005-smart-routing-replaces-model-routes.md, docs/routing/best-provider.md, docs/routing/profiles.md, and CONTRACT-003 only if public route evidence fields are introduced. Required behavior: same sticky key reuses a local endpoint; new sticky keys spread by least load; stale provider utilization falls back to Fizeau leases; fuzzy provider-native model matching remains documented. Out of scope: provider implementation and route engine code.
bead.acceptance: 1. rg -n 'sticky route key|Endpoint utilization|AC-FEAT-004-16|AC-FEAT-004-17|AC-FEAT-004-18' docs/helix/01-frame/features/FEAT-004-model-routing.md succeeds. 2. rg -n 'sticky local endpoint assignment|vllm:num_requests_running|llama-server' docs/helix/02-design/adr/ADR-005-smart-routing-replaces-model-routes.md succeeds. 3. rg -n 'fuzzy-match|AC-FEAT-004-14' docs/helix/01-frame/features/FEAT-004-model-routing.md succeeds. 4. ddx doc stale exits successfully or reports no stale routing docs caused by this change.
